title.zh: BlockTower 声称遭遇 2500 万美元黑客损失，Coinbase 安全问题再度浮现
title.en: Coinbase security issues resurface as BlockTower claims $25M hack loss

current_state.zh:
据 The Cryptonomist 报道，BlockTower Capital 声称遭遇与 Coinbase 相关的 2500 万美元黑客损失，报道称这一说法再次引发外界对 Coinbase 安全漏洞的质疑。Crypto Briefing 报道称，BlockTower 联合创始人 Ari Paul 指控 Coinbase 损失了 BlockTower 的 2500 万美元资金，并对此进行了掩盖。

根据报道的说法，这一指控重新引发外界对 Coinbase 安全实践以及该交易所如何处理机构客户资产的审视。

该指控出自 BlockTower 联合创始人 Ari Paul，其中还包含“掩盖”的说法；相关报道仅停留在标题层面，未披露事件的具体机制，也未提及 Coinbase 的任何回应。
current_state.en: BlockTower claims a $25M hack loss, renewing questions about security vulnerabilities at Coinbase.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: BlockTower claims a $25M hack loss, renewing questions about security vulnerabilities at Coinbase.
updates.detailed_summary_en: BlockTower claims a $25M hack loss, renewing questions about security vulnerabilities at Coinbase.
updates.background_zh: 2024 年 5 月，有报道称 BlockTower Capital 的主要对冲基金遭到欺诈者入侵并被部分抽走资金，当时未披露损失金额。Coinbase 自身此前也披露过安全事件，包括 2023 年 2 月的一起社会工程攻击，攻击者以紧急登录指令联系员工，导致员工数据被窃取。
updates.background_en: In May 2024, BlockTower Capital's main hedge fund was reported to have been compromised and partially drained by fraudsters, with the loss amount not disclosed at the time. Coinbase has previously disclosed security incidents of its own, including a February 2023 social-engineering breach in which employee data was stolen after attackers contacted employees with urgent login requests.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该指控聚焦于通过头部交易所持有的机构资金，因此其直接传导渠道是对交易所托管与主经纪商安排的信心，而非现货流动性或代币供应。交易所安全议题的再度升温可能促使机构客户重新审视资产存放安排，但该指控目前尚未得到证实。
updates.market_impact_en: The claim centers on institutional funds held through a top-tier exchange, so the immediate transmission channel is confidence in exchange custody and prime-brokerage arrangements rather than spot liquidity or token supply. Renewed attention to exchange security can prompt institutional clients to review where assets are held, but the allegation remains unconfirmed.
